citation.title: Spatiotemporal structure of edge harmonic oscillation and its role in ELM-free QH-mode at KSTAR
citation.authors: J. Lee, S. Kim, Y.-M. Jeon, M. Kim, D.-K. Kim, G.S. Yun

topic: Offline ECEI/broadband-ECE characterization of EHO structure, a transport proxy, and transfer-entropy directionality in one KSTAR QH-mode discharge (#32092).
own_question: How the EHO structure relates to E×B shear and edge energy transport. The paper does not address CES nowcasting.
actual_method_and_evidence: The analysis is offline and limited to a single discharge. It uses ECEI optical flow to build a T̃e–ṽr correlation proxy. Transfer entropy and a directionality index are computed over 7.0–7.2 s with phase-randomized surrogates. CES rotation and carbon impurity Ti are window-averaged over about 50 ms and serve only as profile and equilibrium inputs. The paper includes no BES, no prediction, and no real-time component.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR ECEI has been used offline to resolve pedestal electron-temperature fluctuation structure in QH-mode, sampled at about 2 µs.
claim_checks.qualification: These are electron diagnostics from one 2022-era discharge. The paper reports no Ti inference and no 10 ms snapshot use.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: CES is time-averaged over about 50 ms for profile fits. The paper gives no CES report timing or arrival information.
validation_if_relevant: There is no predictive validation. Statistical support consists of surrogate tests for transfer entropy only.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite this paper as showing that ECEI predicts or nowcasts CES Ti.
Do not cite it as evidence of causal estimation in the online sense; its transfer entropy measures directionality, not real-time causality.
Do not generalize its EHO mechanism to our chord or campaign.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most, it could appear as a minor background citation for KSTAR ECEI pedestal capability. It does not bear on our targets, inputs, or validation designs.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
